cachePolicy: No OS cache eviction; one generation session per case, reused across its warmups and measurements, then unloaded
correctness: Every iteration of a case must reproduce its first iteration's pixels exactly. Provided-profile cases must reach the plan's SSIM against the fixture image on the first measured iteration; encoded cases record it (the whole pipeline is not gated in parity either).
hostConditions: Quiet-window availability must be arranged by the operator; this command does not establish system idleness or control other workloads
installedToolchain:
swift-driver version: 1.168.6 Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
memoryScope: Per-iteration maximum observed physical footprint, resident bytes and default Metal device currentAllocatedSize, sampled every 50 ms plus stage boundaries. Counters overlap and must not be summed; brief peaks may be missed.
modelVerificationScope: Model streams hashed before iterations; postflight rechecks source, executable, plan, fixtures and asset declarations. Files must remain immutable during execution.
timingScope: Application-stage wall clock, not GPU kernel timing. Encoded: conditioning includes balanced cleanup and text-encoder load, call and discard; references include the VAE encoder's load, calls and release. denoiserSetup includes segment acquisition and validation; steps include native calls, host copies and Euler updates; decode includes decoder loading when needed, copies and image validation. Stage timings exclude observers (hashing, order checks); total includes them. Preflight, stream verification, one-time setup, SSIM, report IO and unload are outside timed generation.
